I didn't write the files, because your request said not to use any tools and writing to disk needs one. Both files are below, ready to save as `layout.md` and `CLAUDE.md`. I can write them if you lift that restriction.

## layout.md

```markdown
# Claude Code context layout for atlas

| Location | Mechanism | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| `/CLAUDE.md` | Always-loaded project memory | Holds only org-wide rules that apply to every service (commits, `make check`, trunk-based) plus pointers to per-service files. |
| `api/CLAUDE.md` | Directory-scoped CLAUDE.md | Loads only when Claude works in `api/`; carries the `api/gen/` "generated, run `make proto`" quirk. |
| `web/CLAUDE.md` | Directory-scoped CLAUDE.md | Loads only in `web/`; says to use `npm run test:unit`, because `npm test` launches real Playwright browsers. |
| `pipeline/CLAUDE.md` | Directory-scoped CLAUDE.md | Loads only in `pipeline/`; says to set `AIRFLOW_HOME=pipeline/.airflow` before importing DAGs. |
| `.claude/settings.json` (deny rule or PreToolUse hook on `api/gen/**`) | Hook / permissions | Silent overwrites are a costly failure, so block edits deterministically instead of relying on Claude remembering the CLAUDE.md note. |
| Incident-response runbook (20 steps) | Skill, ideally shipped in a company-wide Plugin | It is a long, repeatable procedure that only matters during incidents, so it should load on demand rather than sit in every session. It is identical across teams, so one plugin keeps a single source of truth instead of per-repo copies. |
| Analytics warehouse SQL | MCP server (`.mcp.json` or the analysts' own config) with read-only credentials | Live external data needs a tool connection. Read-only credentials and a permission prompt on queries limit the blast radius, and engineers who don't need it can leave it off. |
| `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md` | User-level memory | Personal preferences stay out of the repo. |

## Deliberately left out
- The runbook text in any CLAUDE.md, since 20 steps would cost tokens in every session.
- Language style guides and anything Claude already knows or that linters enforce.
- Repo structure descriptions that can be discovered from the code.
```

## CLAUDE.md

```markdown
# atlas

Monorepo with three services:
- `api/` — Go, gRPC
- `web/` — React/TypeScript
- `pipeline/` — Python, Airflow

Each service has its own CLAUDE.md with service-specific gotchas. Read it before working there.

## Org-wide rules
- Use conventional commits (`feat:`, `fix:`, `chore:`, ...).
- `make check` must pass before opening any PR.
- Trunk-based development: short-lived branches only, no long-lived branches.

## Other context
- Incident response: use the incident-response skill. Don't improvise the steps.
- Product metrics from the warehouse: use the warehouse MCP tool, read-only.
```

---

Suggested contents for the service files, each only a few lines:

- **`api/CLAUDE.md`**: "Everything under `api/gen/` is generated by `make proto`. Never hand-edit it, because edits are silently overwritten. Change the `.proto` source and re-run `make proto`."
- **`web/CLAUDE.md`**: "`npm test` opens real browsers via Playwright. For unit tests run `npm run test:unit`."
- **`pipeline/CLAUDE.md`**: "DAGs won't import unless `AIRFLOW_HOME=pipeline/.airflow` is set first. Export it before running or testing DAGs."
